# All 60 commands

Every command is typed after the menu skill in Claude Code and Cowork, `/fundadmin:fund <command> <args>`, or called as its own skill, `/fundadmin:fund-<command> <args>`. Codex names the skill: `$fund-<command> <args>`. Use the [plugin installation](/guide/install) for the complete package. Raw skill copies are [developer compatibility only](/guide/install#other-agents-developer-compatibility-only).
